strategy_roster.name: Elli
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > (donchian_high(high,60) + donchian_low(low,60)) / 2 and (donchian_high(high,19) + donchian_low(low,19)) / 2 > (donchian_high(high,60) + donchian_low(low,60)) / 2 and adx(high,low,close,10) > 13
strategy_roster.notes: Kijun is the 60-bar Donchian midpoint and Tenkan the 19-bar midpoint of the documented periods, with ConvertHigh/ConvertLow mapped to ADX(10) thresholds 13/6. The H1/M1 timeframe split, Tenkan-Kijun pip gap and 60/30 pip StartProtection levels are not expressible as percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: XMA Candles
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish colour change of the smoothed candle is a close-EMA crossing above the open-EMA, and the bearish change is the mirror. Length 14 is a fallback because the docs list the parameter name without a value, and the percent StopLoss/TakeProfit fields have no supplied values.

strategy_roster.name: ADX MACD
strategy_roster.notes: The documented aligned ADX+MACD entry is expressed with ADX(14) strength above 25 and MACD(12,26,9) above its signal; the exit fires when ADX weakens or MACD crosses down. The 2% percent stop is documented; the 15-minute timeframe and neural/seasonality filters have no DSL equivalent.

strategy_roster.name: MultiCurrency Template MT5
strategy_roster.notes: This is a multi-symbol basket engine with a martingale averaging block, break-even averaging and trailing across a comma-separated security list, and its two-candle pattern rules are not stated in the docs. Marked non-trading so no signal is fabricated.

strategy_roster.name: CVD Divergence Volume HMA RSI MACD
strategy_roster.entry_long: 2 * ema(close,10) - ema(ema(close,10),10) > 2 * ema(close,25) - ema(ema(close,25),25) and close > 2 * ema(close,10) - ema(ema(close,10),10) and rsi(close,14) > 40 and rsi(close,14) < 70 and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9) and roc(macd(close,12,26),1) > 0 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1.5
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < 2 * ema(close,10) - ema(ema(close,10),10) or rsi(close,14) > 70 or crossbelow(macd(close,12,26), macd_signal(close,12,26,9))
strategy_roster.notes: Hull 20/50 are approximated by 2*EMA-EMA(EMA) at half the documented lengths, keeping the documented RSI 40-70 band, MACD 12/26/9 histogram rise and VolumeMultiplier 1.5 on the 20-bar average. CVD divergence is dropped because tick-level delta is not in the data.

strategy_roster.name: Cycle Biologique
strategy_roster.notes: A sine oscillator is not available, so the documented CycleLength 30 is kept as a zero-centred 30-period cycle and the documented zero crossing entry/exit is applied to it. Amplitude 1.0 and Offset 0 have no effect on the sign rule and are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: CCI Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: CCI(14) is unavailable, so the documented upper/lower level exit-from-extreme is mapped to a 14-bar z-score leaving the +/-2 band, with the opposite signal as the documented exit. The 100/200 point stop and target are price steps, not percentages, so they are left null.

strategy_roster.name: Vortex Indicator Cross
strategy_roster.notes: VI+/VI- are approximated by the competing 14-bar up and down price pressure, so the documented cross of the two lines keeps its directional meaning. Vortex Length 14 is a fallback since the docs list the parameter name only, and price-step stop/target are not percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: Gann Swing Multi Layer
strategy_roster.notes: Three consecutive aligned Gann swing turns are approximated by a close beyond the prior three-bar high with an SMA(7) continuation filter, exiting on the mirrored three-bar low. The multi-layer swing stacking, its multipliers and the 1-minute swing frame are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Simple APF Strategy Backtesting
strategy_roster.notes: Autocorrelation cycle detection and the linear-regression forecast are not available, so the documented forecast-gain entry is proxied by ROC(20) above its own 20-bar mean, and the target-price exit by ROC turning non-positive. Length 20 and the gain/signal thresholds are fallbacks because no values are documented.
